tv_studio.name: TV Studio A
tv_studio.description: The main broadcasting set where Elena Voss was presenting. Lighting scaffolding, spotlight rigs, and cameras face the presenter desk.

editing_room.name: Editing Suite
editing_room.description: A dark console room with sound-absorbing walls, mixers, and video monitors used to queue live feeds.

server_room.description: Cold, humming servers housing the station's network logs, backup recordings, and keycard control systems.

elena_apartment.name: Elena's Apartment
elena_apartment.description: Elena's personal loft. Notebooks, books, and boards show her recent corruption investigations.
